question: The average weight of nine persons is 25 kg. If a new person joins this group, then the average weight becomes 26 kg. What is the weight of the new person?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Weight of the new person = Old Average + (Total Members × Increase in Average)

Old Average = 25 kg, Total Members = 9 + 1 = 10

Increase in Average = 26 − 25 = 1 kg

⇒ Weight = 25 + (10 × 1)

⇒ Weight = 25 + 10 = 35 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 35 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average weight of 9 persons = 25 kg

New average weight (after the 10th person joins) = 26 kg

**Formula Used:**

Total Weight = Average Weight × Number of Persons
